Discard fragments outside the unit disk [S3].

The claim states that fragments outside the unit disk are discarded. The evidence in Source [S3] explicitly confirms this in two places: 1) The summary notes for 'Pass 1 (Visibility pass)' state: 'Discard fragments outside the unit disk.' 2) The provided GLSL code snippet contains the logic: `if (mag_sq > 0.25 /* 0.5^2 */) { discard; // discard fragments outside of point circle }`. Since `gl_PointCoord` ranges from 0 to 1, a distance squared greater than 0.25 corresponds to a distance greater than 0.5 (the radius of the unit disk in this coordinate space), effectively discarding fragments outside the circular point sprite.
